doc.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021

title: His sister's path to New York
summary: His sister, a singer with Sal Salvador's big band, went to New York first.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was a move to New York City a logical step at that time for a young musician?

Well my sister had gone to New York before I had. She worked, and at that time she worked with, she had made a record with Sal Salvador had a big band. And my sister was a singer in the band. And she went to New York a few years before I even thought about going to New York. I don’t think I would have gone to New York had my sister not gone there before I did.
